Hi all - short checklist & lead time estimates below. I kept this high-level so we can share directly with Priya.

Dedicated (recommended first step):
- Typical lead time: 7-10 business days to provision dedicated GPU pool + model deployment if model size < 30B and quantized.
- Requirements: customer account, network allowlist (outbound to redwood control plane), service account cert, model access/manifest.
- KMS: support for AWS KMS for key wrapping is available; requires KMS ARN and a small IAM role config (2-3 business days).
- Audit logs: we can enable 1yr retention; will need to confirm export path (S3 or Splunk).
- SLA: 99.95% uptime option available with reserved capacity SKU.

Private VPC / On-prem (for strict isolation):
- Lead time: 4-8 weeks depending on network approvals and HSM integration.
- Networking: VPC peering or PrivateLink; customer firewall rules and IP allowlist required.
- HSM/KMS: if they require HSM-backed keys, plan for additional scheduling with infra team (2-4 weeks).

For Atlas numbers (800 reqs/min, ~120 tokens/response): rough compute recommendation - 2x A100-80GB equivalent for steady 800 rpm with p95 ~150ms depending on prompt length and model; we can refine after a perf run.

I’ve attached the onboarding checklist and a short tech appendix. Happy to run a short 30-min tech sync w/ Atlas to scope exact throughput.

Laura Bennett
